manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Preserve a bounded official-index case where the registered disclosure page exposes only old-year target-form download-manager PDFs.
search_queries: 入間看護専門学校 情報公開
入間看護専門学校 機関要件確認申請書
steps: Start from the Saitama official-index disclosure URL https://www.i-heiseigakuen.ac.jp/kokai/.
Run strict FY2026 PDF discovery from the prefecture_aggregator SchoolSite.
Follow the WordPress Download Manager wrapper for 様式２（R6年度分申請）.
Reject it from strict FY2026 success as an old-year target form.
Keep the school in the operator-visible publication-lag/manual queue because no target FY2026 confirmation PDF was discoverable from the official entry.

reusable_rules: Treat same-origin WordPress Download Manager wrappers as PDF candidates.
Classify old-year target-form wrappers as publication-lag evidence instead of target-FY success.
Surface the school as manual-required with the official disclosure URL and old-year PDF attached.
anti_patterns: Do not count an official-index URL as PDF acquisition success when it exposes only old-year PDFs.
Do not fabricate a PDF URL from the school root page.

evidence.notes: Windows v231 full Saitama replay crawled the prefecture_aggregator URL and produced fiscal_year_mismatch:2024 for the same-origin WPDMDL 様式２（R6年度分申請） wrapper.
